hero.description: Experience the most breathtaking tandem paragliding flight in Turkey. Launch from Babadağ Mountain and soar above turquoise waters, ancient ruins and the world-famous Blue Lagoon.

whyOludeniz.title: The World's Most Beautiful Paragliding
whyOludeniz.subtitle: Ölüdeniz isn't just a destination — it's the benchmark against which all other paragliding sites are measured.
whyOludeniz.altitudeDesc: Babadağ Mountain gives you one of the highest commercial tandem launches in Europe
whyOludeniz.flightDesc: Long, smooth thermals mean more air time and more views compared to most sites
whyOludeniz.landingDesc: Land directly on Ölüdeniz beach, steps from the famous Blue Lagoon
whyOludeniz.weatherDesc: 300+ flyable days per year thanks to Ölüdeniz's exceptional microclimate
whyOludeniz.safetyDesc: Decades of safe operations with fully certified, internationally licensed pilots
whyOludeniz.viewsDesc: Blue Lagoon, Butterfly Valley, Gemiler Island — all visible from above

flightTypes.title: Every Flight, Perfectly Tailored
flightTypes.subtitle: From first-timers to seasoned pilots — we have the right flight for you.
flightTypes.tandemDesc: Fly with a certified instructor. No experience needed.
flightTypes.acroDesc: Heart-pumping acrobatic manoeuvres with expert pilots.
flightTypes.sunsetDesc: Golden hour over the Blue Lagoon — unforgettable.
flightTypes.xcDesc: Long-distance flights for licensed solo pilots.

babadag.title: Babadağ Mountain — A Paragliding Legend
babadag.desc1: Rising to 1,960 metres above the turquoise waters of Ölüdeniz, Babadağ is not just a mountain — it's the heartbeat of one of the world's greatest paragliding destinations.
babadag.desc2: With four separate launch points ranging from 1,200m to 1,900m, Babadağ caters to every level — from nervous first-timers to world-class acro and XC pilots.
